sentences.text:
Bench: R. Raghunandan Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice R. Raghunandan Rao
 Criminal Petition No.8793 of 2022
Order:

A Crime in F.I.R No.223 of 2022 dated 01.11.2022 has been registered in Kamalapuram Police Station, YSR Kadapa District, against the petitioner under Section 6 (b) of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce,
Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 on the ground that the petitioner was caught storing tobacco and tobacco products.

entities.text: Kamalapuram Police Station, YSR Kadapa District
entities.label: ORG

entities.text:
Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce,
Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. The cases are being booked against persons, who are found to be either storing or transporting tobacco or tobacco products in the State of Andhra Pradesh.

Persons, who are facing such cases,
have been approaching this Court for relief.

3. In Crl.P.No.5421 of 2019 and batch dated 18.12.2019, a learned Single Judge of this Court had held that tobacco does not fall within the definitions of "food" and as such, registration of Crime under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is not permissible.

4. In W.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018, a learned Single Judge of this Court had held the police would not have jurisdiction to initiate or investigate any offences punishable under the provision of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
A learned Single Judge had also held that transport or storage of tobacco and tobacco products would not constitute an offence punishable under Sections 270 to 273 of Indian Penal Code.

5. In view of the aforesaid findings which are being consistently followed by this Court, this Criminal Petition is allowed quashing the F.I.R No.223 of 2022 dated 01.11.2022 has been registered in Kamalapuram Police Station, YSR Kadapa District, against the petitioner with a direction to return the vehicle bearing No. AP 39 UE 4675 as well as the seized tobacco products.

entities.text: Kamalapuram Police Station, YSR Kadapa District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.

R. RAGHUNANDAN RAO, J 08.11.2022 BSM HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE R. RAGHUNANDAN RAO CRIMINAL PETITION No.8793 of 2022 08.11.2022 BSM Rudra Ganesh Reddy vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 8 November, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191034310/
